what: On hover, two hand-drawn rings around the element (radius 1.06× and 1.105×, width 1.2%) are drawn at 10fps in steps of .3→.5→.72 up to 68% of a full turn. After that, every frame redraws them with a freshly picked start point, length (±20%) and radius jitter (±2.8%, 24 points), so the line trembles as if alive. On release they shrink .72→.5→.3 and disappear. The ends taper to a thin point. On touch devices or with always, they stay drawn permanently.
ease: steps — switches section by section with nothing in between

options.sweep: Share of one ring’s turn (0~1), default .68
options.sweep-jitter: Jitter of the rotating share, default .4 (±20%)
options.pad: Offset from the element’s edge (radius ratio), default .06
options.always: If 1, always draws regardless of the interaction (original phone panel)

note: Shaped for round elements (discs · circular photos · pill buttons) — on rectangular elements it stretches into an ellipse. The original draws a band mesh with the same formula over a three disc, follows the disc tilt and catches up late (1−e^(−15·dt)). The part is a flat svg over the element box.
